rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: When I Believed in the Rules
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself who once trusted the institution, tradition, or process. Use its old language even as your confidence slips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to the complaint desk. We used to promise 'a person, not a number.' I still have my badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need my refund today. There's only a ticket machine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take a number. Someone will call it. Someone always did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticket says to post it away and wait six weeks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write 'a person, not a number' on the envelope. They may still recognise it.

card.title: When I Believed in the Rules
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself who once trusted the institution, tradition, or process. Use its old language even as your confidence slips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club always looks after its own. I've paid dues for thirty years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need your locker key. They've rented it to someone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There must be a respectful explanation. Could you check my thirty years?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. They said I can give you a bag for your things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Could it have the club crest? We look after our own. I'm still... one of those.

card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written a checklist so you can safely make tea while I'm out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for forty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You can initial the experience section.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just have water?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cold or room temperature? I need the correct appendix.

card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you borrow my bicycle, let's rehearse what to do if you wobble. I don't want you hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put my foot down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Which foot? I'll tick that side off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever side I'm falling toward. I need to get to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll practise both sides separately. Until both are signed off, you can borrow it for walking.

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first choir concert. I bowed when you did. Was that enough to count me in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Take another bow; they're still clapping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay down until you rise. I don't want to short-change the choir.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm staying down because my shoe's untied. Go and join the others.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll retie mine too. Then we can finish my first bows exactly together.

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's my first club dinner. I've memorised the toast so nobody regrets voting me in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just lift your glass when I do and say 'cheers.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same height as yours? I want to do my part properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Any height. I have to sit; my knee's giving out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lean on me. I'll keep us both standing until the last member lowers their glass.

card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two hours for our stall permit. Imagine how thoroughly they're checking things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The counter's empty. I need to get back to the shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Nobody's being rushed into approving us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can apply online. It says there's a six-week review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Let's join that queue from home. Six weeks of protection, and you can keep the shop open.

card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our street-party application has reached a third committee. Reassuring to have so many safeguards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The first two lost it. I need to book the tables today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And a third stands ready. One lost envelope can't plunge the street into chaos.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want a fresh application. The table company won't hold our booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good thing approval comes first. I'll reapply; you release the tables. Imagine seating everyone before we're protected.

card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tonight's moon audit, who signs the village's findings?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oldest owl. I'm delivering them, but my shift ends at sunset.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can we get its signature before you finish?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It starts at moonrise. I'll stay, but you have to approve my overtime.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved. Put 'waiting for owl' on your timesheet. Who covers delivery if it's cloudy?

card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the dragon's naming ceremony, where do we put the fire extinguishers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dragon eats anyone who brings one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Who handles the insurance exemption?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody insures dragons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the deposit needs to cover the hall.

transfer.action: I polish my old institutional badge beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I used to mean every word of the motto. {request}
transfer.response: Show me where the old promise still holds. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then I need to know which word on the badge stopped being true.

transfer.action: I lay a safety checklist beside {prop}.
transfer.response: A witness line prevents unfortunate uncertainty. {counter}
transfer.closing: Precisely when people underestimate the need for a checklist.

transfer.action: I repeat the ceremonial bow over {prop}, twice as deeply.
transfer.opening: Was that enough to count me in? {request}
transfer.response: I can perform the full version if this one didn't count. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then tell me which step made it happen so I can trust it.

transfer.action: I smile at the long queue beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Look how carefully everyone is being protected. {request}
transfer.response: Another review is a safeguard we hadn't appreciated. {counter}
transfer.closing: An impressively large amount of caution is getting done.

transfer.action: I put the moon-audit ritual beside the timetable for {prop}.
transfer.opening: Fine, an annual moon audit. Who unlocks the room? {request}
transfer.response: The moon can be mysterious; the booking shouldn't be. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'm making sure its spirit has somewhere to park on Tuesday.
